definitions.explanation: Sheer leg coverings typically worn by women, usually made of nylon.

examples.japanese: ストッキングを{履|は}いて{出勤|しゅっきん}する。
examples.english: Wear stockings when going to work.

examples.japanese: ストッキングに{伝線|でんせん}が{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I got a run in my stockings.

examples.japanese: {肌色|はだいろ}のストッキングを{買|か}う。

notes:
ストッキング is a loanword from English 'stocking(s)'. In Japanese, it typically refers to pantyhose rather than thigh-high stockings.

TYPES:
- パンティストッキング (pantyhose, often abbreviated パンスト)
- {膝下|ひざした}ストッキング (knee-high stockings)
- {網|あみ}ストッキング (fishnet stockings)

COLORS:
- {肌色|はだいろ}/ベージュ (nude/beige)
- {黒|くろ} (black)
- {白|しろ} (white)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ストッキングを{履|は}く (to put on stockings)
- ストッキングが{伝線|でんせん}する (to get a run in stockings)
- ストッキングを{脱|ぬ}ぐ (to take off stockings)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Wearing stockings is often considered proper business attire for women in Japanese workplaces, especially with skirts.
